answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling: each grading task is judged by a random panel drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing, where accumulated reputation acts like pigment staining every vote with real cost. Fresh fakes form a jetty that never reaches the water, because new identities are excluded from panels until they stake honest work over time. Every vote carries a verifiable pulse of accountability, so an attacker must grow expensive, long-lived, staked identities they cannot risk corrupting, making fakes costlier than honest participation.
